🇲🇽🏫 <u>SHEINBAUM PROPOSES PUBLIC INSURANCE COMPANY TO RESCUE TEACHERS PENSIONS FROM 2007 LAW</u>

The federal government will create a state-owned insurance company dedicated exclusively to administering and paying retired workers' pensions, coordinated with Pensionissste. Sheinbaum: it "will guarantee a better retirement for teachers, and we'll push it for other state employees." It's a direct response to Calderón's 2007 ISSSTE Law that swapped solidarity pensions for individual Afore accounts and gutted retirement for a generation of maestros. The CNTE calls the offer insufficient — full abrogation of the 2007 law is the floor — but the direction is clear: rebuilding what neoliberalism dismantled, brick by brick.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>CNTE TAKES PROTESTS TO AICM AND ESTADIO AZTECA FOR WORLD CUP INAUGURATION WEEK</u>

CNTE Sección 9 leader Pedro Hernández just announced mobilizations at Mexico City's airport and the Estadio Azteca during the Mundial 2026 opening week, as teachers wrap their fifth day blocking Paseo de la Reforma. The demand hasn't changed since AMLO: repeal Calderón's 2007 ISSSTE Law that scrapped solidarity pensions for individual Afore accounts. Brugada is showcasing stadiums and embarcaderos for the world; the maestros are reminding everyone whose backs the spectacle is built on.

🇲🇽💰 <u>PESO DOWN 1.23% TO 17.48 ON US PAYROLLS + MIDDLE EAST — STILL +0.2% FOR THE WEEK</u>

US non-farm payrolls came in at 172,000 jobs in May, twice the 86,000 markets expected — Fed-rate-cut bets evaporated, dollar bid. Same day, Iran reaffirmed Hezbollah backing and demanded Israeli withdrawal from southern Lebanon. The peso closed Friday at 17.48 per dollar, off 1.23%. Weekly balance still in the green at +0.2%.

External shocks, not internal weakness.

Source: El Financiero

🚨🇲🇽 <u>PETRO ON TRUMP'S COLOMBIA PICK: "THEY COME FROM NARCO-PARAMILITARY GOVERNANCE"</u>

After Trump endorsed Abelardo de la Espriella — a 47-year-old lawyer whose career was built representing narcotraficantes and paramilitares — Colombia's president called it for what it is. Petro to Washington: "I lament that figures and governments that claim to fight drug trafficking are helping to bring crime into political power in Colombia." On de la Espriella's circle: "son genocidas y narcotraficantes." De la Espriella topped the first round May 31 and advanced to the runoff. Iván Cepeda, Petro's left ally, trails.

Source: regeneracion.mx

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>93 BILLION PESOS TO REBUILD WHAT NEOLIBERALISM SOLD FOR PARTS — PEMEX PETROQUÍMICA RETURNS</u>

Pemex plan 2026–2030, broken down: 30B pesos for Ethane-Ethylene, 11B for Aromatics, 13B for Ammonia, 13.7B for the Fertinal-ProAgro fertilizer chain, 25.3B for the Escolín project. Plants reactivated: Cosoleacaque, Cangrejera, Morelos, Poza Rica, Lázaro Cárdenas. Production target: 849,000 tons of petrochemicals + over 4 million tons of fertilizers annually. 25,000 direct jobs, 70,000 indirect.

Sheinbaum: the goal of neoliberalism was "acabar con Petróleos Mexicanos." She's putting it back — using Mexican gas and condensates, not imports.

Source: contralinea.com.mx

🔥🇲🇽 <u>BRAZIL 2016 PLAYBOOK IS LIVE IN MEXICO — JUDICIAL REFORM BLOCKS THE LAVA JATO MOVE</u>

Contralínea lays out the parallel: media manipulation + foreign interference + judicial weaponization took down Dilma after the 2014 World Cup. The same gringo machine is aimed at Sheinbaum heading into the 2026 World Cup. Aníbal García Fernández (UNAM): "if we don't have a lawfare process in Mexico it's because of this Judicial Power reform." Marcela Román (Rosario Castellanos) calls Brazil 2016 "the result of the worst strategies of imperialist foreign intervention in the region." The September 15, 2024 reform — the one the gringo press still calls a "democratic regression" — is exactly what makes a Lava Jato impossible here.

Source: contralinea.com.mx

🇲🇽🚆 <u>INTEROCEÁNICO RAIL GETS REDESIGNED CURVES AFTER DEC 28 DERAILMENT — 14 DEAD</u>

The "Orejas de Conejo" curves near Salina Cruz, Oaxaca — where 14 people died and 98 were injured last December — are being rebuilt to eliminate the sharp turns. TÜV Rheinland delivers its formal safety audit this week; Sheinbaum says the call on resuming passenger service comes in 2–3 weeks. Cargo trains still running.

When the project breaks, you fix it. You don't lease it out to Wall Street.

Source: jornada.com.mx

🇲🇽🇨🇺 <u>SHEINBAUM SHUTS DOWN US PRESSURE ON CUBA, COLOMBIA, BOLIVIA</u>

Trump's Treasury hit Díaz-Canel with sanctions Wednesday — Rubio threatening Colombia's election, Hegseth threatening Bolivia's Rodrigo Paz. Sheinbaum from the mañanera podium: "Each people has to decide who governs them, how they're governed and how they resolve their problems. That is Mexico's position — and not only by conviction, but because it is so in the Constitution of the Republic."

Self-determination of peoples. Article 89. End of debate.

Source: jornada.com.mx
📸 Mañanera del Pueblo — Coatzacoalcos, Veracruz · 5 de junio de 2026
